name: Virgin Islands Visa (Visitor Entry)

requirements.blocker_text: Passport must be valid for at least 6 months from the date of application.
Supporting documents in a foreign language require notarized English translation and apostille certification.

evidence_required.document: Supporting documents (color, legible; notarized/apostilled translation if not in English)

outcome.duration_length: not specified in the sources reviewed; processing takes approximately 4 weeks

sources.title: Government of the Virgin Islands -- Application for Virgin Islands VISA: passport validity, document certification requirements, non-refundable fee, ~4-week processing

notes: NEW COUNTRY, first route of the British Virgin Islands' initial build -- the fifth British Overseas Territory (BOT) built this session, after Anguilla, Montserrat, Cayman, and Bermuda. Same core modelling decision applies as the other four BOTs and is explained once here: Belonger status is BVI's own local right-of-abode-equivalent, NOT British nationality -- actual British Overseas Territories Citizenship (BOTC) is a separate naturalisation track (see vg_naturalisation_botc.json). This visa page does not specify which nationalities require a visa, nor the permitted length of stay for those who do not -- both flagged as gaps; the fee amount was also not disclosed on the page reviewed. Only the confirmed hard requirements (passport validity, document certification) are modelled; no stay-duration or nationality list was invented.
